status_at_preparation: code prepared while V7 synthetic stability gate was running; no V7 candidate process or candidate outcome existed
purpose: Fresh all-ten closure pilot using the prospectively frozen Vivado-2026.1 V7 infrastructure amendment.

unchanged_science.candidate_selection: exact V1 manifest order and raw RTL identities
unchanged_science.constraints: byte-identical V1 closure Tcl; clock and zero-delay I/O XDC before synthesis
unchanged_science.period_search: 0.75/1.25 bracket, 1.5 expansion, [1,200] ns, at most four expansions per side, at most ten bisections, relative width <= 1 percent
unchanged_science.gate: all ten complete; pooled Spearman >= 0.90; median sMAPE <= 0.15; positive mean RF-SFT closure difference with at most one non-tied sign reversal

stop_rules: Do not freeze or launch unless the V7 synthetic gate is a frozen 40/40 PASS.
Freeze and commit this package before the first candidate process.
Run all ten candidates fresh; do not rerun only the V3 failure.
Do not change search, thresholds, retries, or zero scoring after any V7 candidate outcome exists.
A V7 candidate-pilot FAIL remains evidence and blocks the timing-dependent downstream queue.
